svg.aria-label: Propranolol, page 2 of 2. Contraindication Marked bradycardia, greater-than-first-degree heart block without pacing, cardiogenic shock or decompensated heart failure; hypersensitivity. Bronchial asthma. Adverse reaction Severe bradycardia/heart block, worsening heart failure, hypotension and bronchospasm. Side effects Fatigue, dizziness, cold extremities; sleep or gastrointestinal disturbances. Special notes Do not stop abruptly. Can mask hypoglycemia symptoms; monitor heart rate and BP. Selectivity is dose-dependent, not absolute. Correct spelling: propranolol, not propanolol.
